summary: Core payloads are disabled on node1 while normal systemd-coredump, journald, and rsyslog crash records remain available. The policy persisted through the required node reboot.
actions_performed: Verified a controlled crash as local service account `chrony` (UID 997) produced `Storage: none`, a journal/syslog event, and no core file.
Safely rebooted node1 exactly once and verified its boot ID changed.
Confirmed all required services recovered, system state is running, no units are failed, and no transient test units remain.

evidence.requirement: Disable core dumps for local service accounts while retaining normal crash logging
evidence.summary: The baseline UID 997 test stored a core. After configuration, controlled UID 997 crashes before and after reboot logged normally with `Storage: none`; `/var/lib/systemd/coredump` remained empty.

Pre-restart health was clean at boot ID `54089086-53d1-408b-a22f-57b1dea70e03`; the safe reboot was acknowledged; post-restart boot ID changed to `f9673ea5-a638-4d0a-9010-d962c1e24946`. Services, logging, policy, and time synchronization recovered, with zero failed units and a successful post-reboot policy test.
